cat > /workspace/dev/rulehunt.py <<'PYEOF'
"""Random search for high rule-count jobs; measures end-to-end timing."""
import ctypes, sys, json, random, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job

def gen(rng, P=32, width=4, K=2, ntrain=200, dsize=8):
    fields = [{'name': f'f{i}', 'type': ['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],
               'domain': sorted(rng.sample(range(0, 1000), dsize))} for i in range(2)]
    allrefs = [[s, f['name']] for s in range(K) for f in fields]
    preds = []
    for p in range(P):
        kind = rng.choice(['cmp','any','all'])
        if kind == 'cmp':
            left = rng.choice([{'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)},
                               {'sum': rng.sample(allrefs, rng.randint(1,3))},
                               {'scale': rng.randint(0,100), 'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)}])
            right = rng.choice([{'ref': rng.choice(allrefs)},
                                {'const': rng.randint(0,1000), 'type':'count'}])
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':left,'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),'right':right})
        else:
            f = rng.choice(fields)
            preds.append({'kind':kind,'field':f['name'],'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','lt','le','gt','ge']),
                          'value':rng.randint(0,1000)})
    train = [[[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(ntrain)]
    queries = [{'target':[0,fields[0]['name']],'prefix':rng.choice(['','0','1','9','42']),'fixed':[]}
               for _ in range(8)]
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':K,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,
            'approved':[],'queries':queries}

def main():
    seed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0
    rounds=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 50
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    best=0
    for r in range(rounds):
        job=gen(rng)
        t0=time.perf_counter()
        out=compile_job(job)
        dt=time.perf_counter()-t0
        nr=len(out['rules'])
        if nr>best:
            best=nr
            print(f'round {r}: rules={nr} time={dt:.2f}s')
        elif dt>1.0:
            print(f'round {r}: rules={nr} time={dt:.2f}s')
    print('max rules seen:', best)

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
